convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Expert.mqh, SignalAlligator.mqh, TrailingNone.mqh, MoneyFixedLot.mqh) for trading logic, signal generation, and money management. The core signal logic is encapsulated in CSignalAlligator class which must be manually examined and reimplemented.

derived_values.name: CrossMeasure - number of bars to confirm crossover

other_exits: Signal reversal handled by CExpert framework - opposite signal closes existing position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size; Percent parameter (10.0) is used for margin/freemargin check but lot size is fixed at 0.1

custom_logic_notes: The CrossMeasure parameter (default 5) controls how many bars the Lips must remain above/below the Teeth+Jaw before a signal is confirmed. This is specific to CSignalAlligator and must be extracted from SignalAlligator.mqh for accurate conversion. The CExpert base class handles position management including closing on opposite signals. Expert_EveryTick=false means signal is evaluated once per bar, not every tick.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement CSignalAlligator logic: the Alligator indicator uses iAlligator() which maps directly to pandas_ta.alligator() or manual SMMA calculation. CrossMeasure logic requires examining SignalAlligator.mqh to understand the exact crossover confirmation algorithm (likely checks if Lips stay above/below for N consecutive bars). CExpert framework logic (position gating, signal reversal close, margin checks) must be manually replicated. No digit adjustment needed as SL/TP are not used. Position sizing is trivial (fixed 0.1 lots). Main effort is extracting the exact entry signal logic from the .mqh include.
